ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85:15 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity dark-grey/black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white region across both lobes; continuous low-intensity dark border mapping the entire trailing edge and distal tips; a distinct dark vertical line is visible at the midline base of the fluke.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with an approximate internal angle of 50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency and high-amplitude serrations present along the full extent of the trailing edge; peaks are sharp and irregular, particularly concentrated on the outer lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical posterior sweep with convex leading edges tapering to sharp distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial cluster of circular, low-contrast annular patterns (rosettes) visible on the left lobe; dense dark pixel clusters at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A singular small dark focal marking located approximately 40 pixels inferior to the center of the median notch; significant irregular jaggedness of the trailing edge boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of high-intensity specular highlights (water spray reflections) scattered primarily over the left lobe surface.
